design: Marker protocol 2 uses __SCM_CASE_x_<lowercase UTF-8 hex>__ inside the already reserved CASE namespace; x is never a valid legacy case mask
Payload can only encode a recognized reserved prefix, preserving case; arbitrary payloads and noncanonical token spelling fail
Encoding and decoding each use one pass; complete valid marker spans are skipped so overlapping closing underscores cannot synthesize a second token
New ledgers are schema 3 and new view manifests schema 2, both explicitly pin marker_version 2; prior schemas retain marker version 1
Existing import journal/receipt bytes do not change; direct agent interfaces remain only read_safe_file and write_safe_file

first_integration.explanation: Two prior tests required all forward encoding to reject raw syntax; now explicitly retain that assertion for legacy protocol 1. One prior test required new ledgers to be schema 2; now checks schema 3 and the explicit marker pin. Reverse corruption checks were not weakened.

original_gap.observed: Input already contains reserved literal or case markers
